notes.title: Trying the New Game+ Live Playthrough Event!
notes.content: Embark on a journey through the realms of Agaris once more in our live New Game + playthrough event! Dive deeper into the mysteries of the past, present, and future as we revisit beloved characters, uncover hidden secrets, and unravel the threads of destiny. Don't miss this epic quest, exclusively on Steam!

notes.title: Nominate The Trilogy of Time for the Steam Awards 2023!
notes.content: I humbly extend an invitation to consider our Trilogy of Time games for the Steam Awards 2023. Your support means the world to us, and your vote would be an honor. Let's continue this incredible journey together. Thank you for being part of our gaming universe! 🚀🎮

notes.title: Unlock Adventure: Follow for an Exclusive Demo of Ettrian - The Elf Prince
notes.content:
Join our Metthink Universe page today, and once we hit 100 followers, we'll reward your loyalty with an exclusive and extensive demo of Ettrian - The Elf Prince! 🏹🌌

By following us, you'll not only stay in the loop with all our updates, but you'll also be among the very first to embark on this epic journey. Don't wait; seize this chance for an early taste of the magic!

Thank you for being an essential part of this community. Together, we'll unlock the adventure of a lifetime!
